create_generic_ssl_dataset: create a GenericSSLDataset instance to load self-supervised learning data from multiple sources with configurable transforms
load_ssl_dataset_labels: load labels from disk_filelist, disk_folder, or torchvision_dataset sources for downstream evaluation
get_ssl_dataset_item: get a transformed sample from the SSL dataset including image data, labels, validity flags, and indices
limit_ssl_dataset_samples: limit dataset size using balanced or unbalanced sub-sampling with configurable seed and skip parameters
get_ssl_dataset_batchsize: get the batch size per replica and compute the global batch size across all distributed trainers
